h: "For You Hear the Sound of the Shofar": Malchuyos, Zichronos and Shofaros on Shabbos

p: "For You hear the sound of the shofar
and give ear to the teruah," etc.
Now on Shabbos, when we do not blow,
it would seem that one ought
since there is no sound of shofar and teruah.
עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לב, א)
based on what they said (Rosh Hashanah 32a):
correspond to the Ten Commandments, etc.;
correspond to the ten utterances, etc."
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג יא, סוֹף עַמּוּד ב)
"Ten utterances in the act of Creation
and ten utterances at the giving of the Torah," etc.;
and they correspond to the ten Sefiros, as is known.
We say ten pesukim of Malchuyos,
for it is stated in the Gemara (ibid. 16a):
so that you make Me King over you";
and this is based on what they said
(in Pesach Eliyahu, Introduction to Tikkunei Zohar):
which is the crown of kingship."
This is why we say ten Malchuyos:
to accept the yoke of His kingship,
up to the root, the attribute of Keser,
"And they shall be for you a remembrance
that one can point to with a finger.
And this is only with the revelation
as it was at the splitting of the Yam Suf,
about which they said in the holy Zohar
will point with his finger, etc.,
for then the attribute of "Hu" will be revealed,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רצ, א)
דְּלִפְנֵי ה׳ הוּא כְּמוֹ עַל ה׳,
which indicates the attribute of Atika,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג עט, ב).
so that your remembrance may rise
up to the attribute of Keser Elyon.
also reach up to the root;
and knowledge is pleasant to your soul";
and Daas is the inner dimension of Keser Elyon,
But on Shabbos, when we do not blow,
that it said "And with what? With the shofar"?
But according to what we have said,
that through the shofar that we blow
and it is from Hashem Yisbarach's side:
into the depths of the heart of Yisrael.
And it is stated in the holy Zohar
who dwell in the air of the Holy Land
are those who know the teruah," etc.
and it corresponds to the attribute of Malchus.
And on Shabbos one merits the heritage of Yaakov,
"And you shall spread out westward and eastward," etc.;
there is the holiness of Eretz Yisrael
"Who spreads the sukkah of peace over us,"
are as if we were offering them,
for our true will is to offer,
only that we are prevented by force,
since we have no Beis HaMikdash;
and "if one was prevented and did not do it,
as if he had done it" (Kiddushin 40a).
"And the Mussaf of this day so-and-so
we will prepare and offer with love," etc.
"'With trumpets and the sound of the shofar
הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ ה׳ (תְּהִלִּים צח, ו),
sound a teruah before the King, Hashem' (Tehillim 98:6) —
trumpets and the sound of the shofar."
And we have said that the shofar, as is known,
"Shall a shofar be blown in the city
from our master, HaRav Reb Ber,
that is, the root of the unification of
Kudsha Brich Hu and His Shechinah.
And this is what they said (Taanis 26b):
וּבְיוֹם שִׂמְחַת לִבּוֹ (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ג, יא)
"'And on the day of the joy of his heart' (Shir HaShirim 3:11) —
this is the building of the Beis HaMikdash."
And there there are trumpets and the sound of the shofar,
that outside the Mikdash, when it falls on Shabbos,
we say ten pesukim of Shofaros:
and the holiness of the Mikdash,
and there is also the mitzvah of shofar,
but in potential and not in actuality.
up to the root, to the aspect of Daas,
which is the inner dimension of Keser Elyon,
truly hears the sound of the shofar;
and on Shabbos too one merits
what they said in the Gemara,
And with what? With the shofar" —
hears the sound of the shofar.
where they offer korbanos in actuality,
therefore when Rosh Hashanah falls on Shabbos
And through the mitzvah of Shabbos
one merits the aspect of the crown-tip of the yud,
which shines from Keser Elyon into Chochmah
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג י, ב וְעוֹד),
(as is written in Zohar III 10b and elsewhere);
and it is the light of Melech HaMashiach,
and it is a light that has not been revealed
at all as yet in this world.
That is the light of the crown-tip of the yud,
of which there is no revelation whatsoever
for even Moshe Rabbeinu, alav hashalom,
attained only the aspect of Daas,
which is the inner dimension of Keser Elyon;
but the light of Keser Elyon
has not yet been attained in this world,
and it is the light of Mashiach,
which they will merit in the future.
And in the Mikdash, when there is both Shabbos
one merits the light of Keser Elyon itself,
And on Shabbos — since through keeping Shabbos
when Rosh Hashanah falls on Shabbos
and to merit the light of Mashiach.
always hears on Shabbos the sound of the shofar
through the ten pesukim of Shofaros,
and the holiness of the Mikdash,
and through the longing to offer it is reckoned
even though we have no Mikdash:
"if one was prevented and did not do it,
as if he had done it," as mentioned above.

paragraphs.text: Rosh Hashanah 32a — "These ten Malchiyos — corresponding to what? Rebbi said: Corresponding to the ten praises that David said in the book of Tehillim… Rav Yosef said: Corresponding to the Ten Commandments… Rabbi Yochanan said: Corresponding to the ten utterances with which the world was created."

paragraphs.text: Zohar III 11b (Vayikra) — "Ten utterances for the act of Creation… ten utterances for the Giving of the Torah — the Ten Commandments. It is written, 'I am Hashem your G-d,' and in the act of Creation, 'Let there be light, and there was light.' This faith in the Holy One is called light: 'Hashem is my light' (Tehillim 27:1)." Yehi Or stands parallel to Anochi.

paragraphs.text: Rosh Hashanah 16a — "Why did the Torah say to pour water on the festival? The Holy One said: Pour water before Me on the festival, so that the rains of the year be blessed for you. And say before Me on Rosh Hashanah Malchiyos, Zichronos and Shofaros: Malchiyos — so that you crown Me King over you; Zichronos — so that your remembrance rise before Me for good; and with what? With the shofar."

paragraphs.text: Parallel: R. Gershon Henoch of Radzin, Sod Yesharim, Rosh Hashanah 15 — “As they said (Rosh Hashanah 16a): Say before Me on Rosh Hashanah Malchuyos, Zichronos and Shofaros: Malchuyos, so that you make Me King over you… Zichronos, so that your remembrance rise before Me for good. And with what? With the shofar… that you contract yourselves to nullify all your will to the simple Will, blessed be He, and this contraction is called shofar.” Connection: Both expound “so that you make Me King over you” and what Malchuyos, Zichronos and Shofaros accomplish.

Why? Because the splitting of the Red Sea depends on Atika."

Because all ascend to one level, one is joined to the other, and the joy of one with the other is found only when the Holy Atika is revealed; and then there is joy for all."

paragraphs.text: Zohar III 231b (Pinchas) — "'Fortunate is the people that knows the teruah' (Tehillim 89:16): it does not say 'who hear' or 'who blow' the teruah, but 'who know' the teruah — for the wise who dwell in the air of the Holy Land know the teruah, the secret of the teruah… and all who know the secret of the teruah will come near to walk in the light of the face of the Holy One; and this is the primordial light that the Holy One hid away for the righteous."

paragraphs.text: Taanis 26b (Mishnah) — "Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said: There were no festive days for Israel like the fifteenth of Av and Yom Kippur, on which the daughters of Yerushalayim would go out in borrowed white garments, so as not to shame one who had none… And so it says, 'Go forth and gaze, O daughters of Tziyon, upon King Shlomo, upon the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding and on the day of the joy of his heart' (Shir HaShirim 3:11): 'on the day of his wedding' — this is the giving of the Torah; 'and on the day of the joy of his heart' — this is the building of the Beis HaMikdash, may it be rebuilt speedily in our days."

p: regarding the conclusion of the blessing of Shofaros,
"For You hear the sound of the shofar
and give ear to the teruah,"
עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּסִפְרֵי הַאֲזִינוּ, פִּיסְקָא שו)
based on what they said (Sifrei Haazinu, Piska 306):
"Because Moshe was close to the heavens,
for he was far from the heavens,
for he was close to the earth."
He hears the sound of the shofar from afar,
and gives ear to the teruah —
based on what they said in the holy Zohar
"Teruah is from the side of Yaakov";
"Tekiah is from the side of the right,
shevarim from the side of the left,
teruah from the side of both of them."
"'And the teruah of the King is in him' (Bamidbar 23:21) —
"For the children of Yisrael, the people close to Him";
giving ear from close by, as mentioned above.
and this is the brain on the right,
That is: Chochmah is the brain,
and there is the place of memory;
even in the brain, where there is memory.
is "a place where there is no forgetting
and forgetting does not exist in it"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב צב, ב),
and it is as it says
(in the blessing of Zichronos in the Rosh Hashanah Mussaf):
"There is no forgetting before the Throne of Your Glory."
the aspect of Atika, as mentioned above,
that is, when there shines forth
from the crown-tip of the yud,
then there is no forgetting at all,
since "there is no forgetting in it
and forgetting does not exist in it."
Therefore on Shabbos in the Mikdash,
לְאוֹר תָּגוֹ שֶׁל יוֹד כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל,
the light of the crown-tip of the yud, as mentioned above,
higher and higher, up to the root:

inlineHeadings.text: Hearing from afar, giving ear from close by

paragraphs.text: Sifrei, Haazinu 306 — "Another explanation: 'Give ear (ha'azinu), O heavens' — because Moshe was close to the heavens, he said 'Give ear, O heavens'; and because he was far from the earth, he said 'and let the earth hear the words of my mouth.' Yeshayahu came and matched it: 'Hear, O heavens' (Yeshayahu 1:2) — for he was far from the heavens; 'and give ear, O earth' — for he was close to the earth."
